Discuss one theme from a stimulus of two statements, using a range of accurate language.
Carry out independent research on a theme or interest related to Italian-speaking society.
Summarise at least two written sources and give a personal response.
Answer questions and discuss the research.
Use gender, plurals, and definite, indefinite and partitive articles with prepositions.
Use agreement, position, apocopation, comparatives, superlatives and demonstrative, indefinite, possessive and interrogative adjectives.
Use cardinal and ordinal numerals and express time and date.
Form adverbs in -mente and use quantifiers and interrogative adverbs.
Use subject, object, disjunctive, reflexive, relative, demonstrative, indefinite, possessive and interrogative pronouns, with ci and ne.
Use simple and complex prepositions and coordinating and subordinating conjunctions.
Conjugate regular, modal, irregular and reflexive verbs and use impersonal and negative forms.
Use present, perfect, imperfect, future, conditional, pluperfect and (receptively) past historic tenses.
Use the passive, continuous tenses with stare, gerund and participles.
Use the subjunctive in present, perfect, imperfect and pluperfect forms, including hypothetical clauses with se.
Handle negation, questions, commands, word order inversion and time expressions with da and fa.
